text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hanako! Hanako is having a baby!
Yahoo! Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Listen to this!
She's a super friendly cow!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Just now, the farm I visit all the time
called me! So exciting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle had been ecstatic, but then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Actually, I got a call
from the farm just now...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hanako went into labor.
But it sounds like a difficult birth...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I've helped back home before,
and giving birth is life-threatening for a cow...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So, ...
Uuuu~~... Hanako...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Dober? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give you this, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What's this...? A Japanese omamori?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What Mejiro Dober handed over...
was a charm for safe childbirth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I heard about
your cow friend.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So, why don't we pray with this charm?
It might bring a blessing or something.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Dober...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober's suggestion...
affirmative...
Neo Universe will also... provide "cooperation."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Establishing "transmission" with "DETN"...
Manipulating the calf's "causality"... Hmmmm...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, that's not like you.
Stop moping around and stand tall!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
If our ever-cheerful little pony makes a face like that,
the cow will start worrying too, you know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Universe...! Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who showed all of us
how important it is to stay positive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So right now, let's look forward.
Let's believe your friend will be okay... right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—YES! Hanako will definitely be okay!
A healthy baby is gonna be born for sure!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In that case, there's no time to sulk around!
My experience back home will surely come in handy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go help deliver the baby!
Please grant me permission to leave campus!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Good luck, Taiki...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We all saw Taiki Shuttle off.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —Taiki, how are things over there?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: 『Everyone! Listen to this voice!』

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES...! Both Hanako and the calf
are safe and sound...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm just... so happy...!
Uuu... uuuuugh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: 『Fufu... Congratulations, Taiki.』

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
『I'll let everyone else know too.
Make sure to tell us all about it when you get back.』

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...! Okey-dokey...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Taiki Shuttle went around showing
pictures of the calf to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm home! I'm officially back!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Welcome back, Taiki. So... how was it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I didn't make it in time
for the birth itself.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
BUT Hanako is totally fine!
She gave birth to a healthy baby!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES! And everyone,
very, VERY thank you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's positivity
made me feel super fine!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
In other words, a cycle of positivity!
It goes around and makes all happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna spread even more positivity
and pay everyone baaaack!!
